messages:
Maya R.: Starting prod deploy for service-inference @ 2026-03-14T11:00 PT (in ~15m). Release notes here: https://redwood.app/releases/2026-03-14 — please skim. Plan: rolling canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Backout runbook: https://confluence.redwood/internal/backouts/service-inference-runbook. Confirm on-call and that model pin (v2.3.1) is set.
DeployBot: Canary started · stage=canary · target=10% · commit=abc1234 · ETA ~5m. Monitoring links: https://dash.redwood/model-inference (latency, errors, unit-cost).
Olga: @Maya R. on-call is Sanjay K. I applied the runtime pin: model=service-inference:v2.3.1 (pin-id=pin-789). :white_check_mark:
Sanjay K.: Reading runbook now. Quick copy of critical abort steps for visibility:

```
# immediate abort to previous stable
releases abort --service inference --to-commit abc1220 --reason "fallback"

# alternative: pin previous image
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/inference inference=image:2026-03-10
```

Kevin L.: DB migration? This change is model/runtime only — no schema. Confirmed no DB steps.

OpsBot: Checklist update: canary metrics OK — p90 latency +2%, error rate 0.06% (< threshold). Proceed to 50%? :thumbsup:

Maya R.: Proceed to 50%. Reminder: we have a cost-fallback route to quantized model v2.2.8 if token cost or latency spikes. Routing policy id: route-045.

Release Coord: I'll add an explicit "quick abort" section to the release notes with the two commands above + links to the runbook and the incident playbook. Updating now.

DeployBot: Canary -> 50% complete · commit=abc1234 now at 50% traffic. Monitoring window started (5m).

Sanjay K.: Trigger criteria for abort (my checklist): errors > 1% OR p90 latency increase > 40% sustained for >2m OR cost per request spikes >2x. If triggered, I'll run:

`ops rollback --service inference --to-tag v2026-03-10 --reason "auto-backout"
`

I'll be on standby for the next 20m.

Olga: Good call. I also pinned the runbook link at the top of the change window doc and pushed a short snippet into #eng-oncall so SRE can see it quickly. :rocket:

Maya R.: Thanks all — if green at the 15m mark we finish to 100% and close the change window. I'll post final status here."
